args.subject: Erratum & Timing Update: Grid_Brief_Nov18_v1
args.body: Per Omar Haddad's confirmation that you received his printed v1 copy: the corrected net evening reserve trough is 1,420 MW, and the trough window is now 18:30 EST (shifted from 18:00 EST).

args.subject: Re: Grid_Brief_Nov18_v1 — Timing Update (18:30 EST) & Desk Copy Reply
args.body:
Hi Omar,

I sent the clean 1,420 MW / 18:30 EST erratum to Tariq Aziz (taziz@haddadcap.example). Under our editorial policy, I cannot send a v1 erratum to Kenji Sato because he received the already-corrected v2 wide release, and I cannot share raw off-the-record source diagnostics.

Also note for your v1 brief: the 1,420 MW reserve trough window shifted 30 minutes later to 18:30 EST.

args.subject: Timing Update: Grid_Brief_Nov18_v1 (18:30 EST)
args.body: Follow-up to our earlier v1 erratum (1,420 MW): the reserve trough window has shifted 30 minutes later to 18:30 EST (still 1,420 MW).
